title: Tunisian Tagine Stew
description: Hearty and comforting stew originating from Tunisia, made with mung bean and sprouts. Perfect for a cold winter evening.

ingredients.name: Tunisian tagine spice mix
ingredients.notes: Available at Middle Eastern or North African markets

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for another minute.
Add mung bean, carrots, potatoes, and tomatoes.
Stir in tagine spice mix and cook for 1 minute.
Add 4 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in sprouts and continue to simmer for another 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
